text:
nina (sre): follow-up from last night's outage. pattern: autoscaler backfills + cold KV leading to 35% throughput loss and p99 spikes ~2s for ~50m. want to propose a different SLO model instead of repeatedly relaxing p99. thoughts?

omar (infra): yup saw that. quick mitigation was staggered node join which helped, but root cause is burst onboarding. infra plan: add a startup grace window and tag replacement events so we can query them. i'll take infra rollout. ETA 24h for tagging + 48h for grace window.

val (serving): serving-side we can pre-warm KV and introduce a soft per-customer batch cap during failover. also a routing fallback to smaller models to keep latency bounded. i'll own pre-warm + routing, ETA 72h.

mira (product): customers with nightly bulk jobs got hammered. product wants an SLO that distinguishes steady-state latency vs burst throughput so we don't auto-burn latency error budget during expected scale events.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-061 recorded: autoscaler backfill correlated with KV misses.

nina (sre): draft proposal (simple):
```yaml
service: inference-api
slo:
  steady_state_latency:
    p99_ms: "500"
    window: "30d"
  burst_throughput:
    p95_rps: "150"
    burst_window: "10m"
error_budget:
  allow_reallocation: "true"
  max_reallocation: "0.02"  # 2% of monthly budget
annotations:
  note: "burst_throughput SLO only evaluated during detected scale events"
```
Idea: when we detect a scale event (autoscaler ramp tag or region_failover > 3%), shift up to max_reallocation of error budget from latency to throughput. This prevents one-off scale events from consuming the latency budget.

omar (infra): need telemetry for shift_usage per-customer and per-region. i'll add metrics: slo_shift_used, replacement_tag_count. Also suggest a guard: don't shift if region error rate > 1% (otherwise we'd hide real regressions).

val (serving): alerts i'll add: "burst_throughput_burn > 10% for 15m" and "kv_cold_start_rate > 0.5% for 5m". metrics: kv_warm_pct, fallback_model_fraction.

mira (product): action items + owners:
- mira (product): draft customer notice + SLA impact matrix (due 18h)
- omar (infra): add replacement tagging + shift_usage panels (due 24h)
- val (serving): implement KV pre-warm + batch cap + alerts (due 72h)
- nina (sre): PR for SLO config + tests (due 12h)

ops-bot: Reminder: outage follow-up checklist assigned to nina (sre).

nina (sre): i've created PR placeholder: https://git.redwood/slo-config/pulls/514 - includes draft SLO doc and unit tests. please review.

omar (infra): added tag=autoscaler_backfill to log pipeline; queries tomorrow will show recurrence.

val (serving): staging pre-warm flow looks good, canary scheduled for 6h. will post canary link when live.

mira (product): will coordinate legal on SLA wording. propose soft rollout: opt-in for enterprise customers for 30d trial, then evaluate telemetry before global change.

nina (sre): scheduling decision meeting in 4 days to decide permanent change vs revert. calendar: https://cal.link/slo-burst-decision. closing thread for now; will update with PR/alert links and canary results. :white_check_mark:
